`program.pte` is a synthetic ExecuTorch `ET12` FlatBuffer generated by
`pteFixture()` in the MIT-licensed [omni-viewer-core fixture builder](https://github.com/battlecook/omni-viewer-core/blob/main/src/parsers/pte/__tests__/fixture.ts).
It contains `forward` and `delegated` methods, kernel and XNNPACK delegate
instructions, tensor metadata, and an extended header locating constant,
delegate, named-data, and mutable-state segments. Payload bytes are test data.

`notebook.ipynb` is a synthetic nbformat v4 notebook created for adapter tests.
It contains Markdown/math, code and raw cells, saved text/HTML/PNG/SVG/JSON outputs,
an error traceback, and an embedded one-pixel PNG. Unsafe HTML, remote image,
and traversal references verify sanitization and the vault asset boundary.

`arrays.npz` was generated for these tests with NumPy's `np.savez_compressed`:
a 3×4 float32 `weights` array (`arange(12) / 4`) and an int64 `ids` array
(`[7, 8, 9]`).

`add.pt2` was generated with PyTorch 2.13.0's documented `torch.export` API from
a one-op module (`forward(x) = x + 10` on a 5-element float32 input) and saved
with `torch.export.save`. torch writes ZIPs that JSZip rejects, which the
detection test relies on.

The NumPy `.npy` arrays and the OpenVINO IR (`.xml` + `.bin`) are synthesized
inside `numpyPt2Openvino.test.mjs`.

`arrow-lz4.feather.b64` and `arrow-zstd.feather.b64` are synthetic Feather V2
interoperability fixtures from the MIT-licensed [omni-viewer-core fixture generator](https://github.com/battlecook/omni-viewer-core/blob/main/src/parsers/arrow/__tests__/fixtures/generate.py).
PyArrow writes three rows with int64, dictionary string, decimal, list and struct
columns, custom metadata and two record batches using LZ4 or ZSTD compression.
The Font tests use the KaTeX fonts already installed with this project.
